10118|c6fbc16f.name: Nessa Shadowsong
10118|c6fbc16f.text: The fish off the coast of Teldrassil are quite large and robust.  Rumors say it is the speedy growth of our new world tree that is the cause.

11081|cb7eee8e.name: Faldron
11081|cb7eee8e.text: Many animals lost their lives so that we could gain these materials. Do not take their sacrifice lightly, $N. Handle the leather with the respect it deserves.

11083|9dd7b921.name: Darianna
11083|9dd7b921.text: Oh, I'm sorry, but you know more about leather than I do at this point. Talk to Faldron over there if you wish to learn more.

3607|c2467ddc.name: Androl Oakhand
3607|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

3649|17d06d6c.name: Thundris Windweaver
3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

3702|5ae56d71.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
3702|5ae56d71.text: Hello $r, it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

4146|08830bac.name: Jocaste
4146|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

4156|c2467ddc.name: Astaia
4156|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

4210|0c543544.name: Alegorn
4210|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4211|a28d29e1.name: Dannelor
4211|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6737|41276936.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

1001-progress.name: Unknown
1001-progress.text: The machine's hatch is open and it seems to wait expectantly for 3 Thresher Eyes to be placed inside.
1001-progress.title: Buzzbox 411

1141-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1141-progress.text:
There's plenty of good dishes you use Darkshore groupers for.  They're good to eat, but I think it's more fun catching them.

You caught any Darkshore groupers yet?
1141-progress.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

1579-progress.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1579-progress.text: Did you find my gaffer jacks, $N?  Without my gaffer jacks I can't tune my stintle pegs!
1579-progress.title: Gaffer Jacks

1580-progress.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1580-progress.text: Did you find any electropellers?  I'll need them if I'm to continue my research on duck decoys...
1580-progress.title: Electropellers

2178-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-progress.text: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?
2178-progress.title: Easy Strider Living

3524-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-progress.text: It is only recently that these creatures started landing on the coast of Darkshore in such alarming numbers.  I can't help but think that this is an ill omen of some sort.  Recovering a sample of that creature's bones to the south would help us in Darnassus assess this situation!
3524-progress.title: Washed Ashore

4681-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-progress.text: Once you have investigated the creature's remains in the water to the west of here, I should be able to file a proper report with the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.  Perhaps then we will be closer to discovering the reason why these unfortunate creatures choose to end their lives beached on the coast of Darkshore.
4681-progress.title: Washed Ashore

4723-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4723-progress.text:
Perhaps one day we'll find a means to prevent these poor creatures from ending their lives needlessly on the coast of Darkshore.  Until then, we must continue our research!

Greetings $N - what news do you bring?
4723-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4727-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4727-progress.text: Hello once again $N - have you found any more beached creatures that the Temple of the Moon should know about?
4727-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

947-progress.name: Barithras Moonshade
947-progress.text: Do you have my mushrooms, $N?  Have you been to the cave?
947-progress.title: Cave Mushrooms

955-progress.name: Asterion
955-progress.text: Once I have the earrings, I will cast the spell to search for the whereabouts of the seal that binds me. For centuries I have thought on the freedom destroying the seal would bring to me... Perhaps those centuries have taken a toll upon my mind that I might never recover...
955-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

956-progress.name: Asterion
956-progress.text:
The pillars of this shrine are as the bars of a prison to me, $N. No strength I still possess might break them, and no magic I wield might destroy them...

For a thousand years and more I have stared at them, wondering if at long last I outlived even the stone, would I be free? Or would it be invisible bars that held me then...
956-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

958-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-progress.text: If only the tools of their undoing could have been destroyed in the cataclysm that destroyed our world... Nonetheless, we must do what we can to ensure that the horrors of our past are not repeated in the future.
958-progress.title: Tools of the Highborne

963-progress.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-progress.text: With a great sorrow in my heart, I followed the Shan'do Stormrage into hibernation, and took my sorrow to my dreams, sleeping for the passing of thousands of years.
963-progress.title: For Love Eternal

98025-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-progress.text: Greetings, $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025-progress.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

982-progress.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-progress.text: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
982-progress.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea

983-progress.name: Unknown
983-progress.text: Buzzbox 827 sits with an eerie silence. A single flashing light indicates that it needs 6 Crawler Legs to be placed in its holding box.
983-progress.title: Buzzbox 827
